Ron Hart Data Centers
Evidence: National security pretext, Corporate defense, Local environmental concerns
#Aletheia #AI #Tech

Local opposition is driven by documented physical concerns over massive water usage, grid strain, and noise pollution, with zero evidence of Chinese bot orchestration.

The author invents a foreign conspiracy theory to dismiss legitimate local environmental and economic concerns, protecting corporate interests.

The author commits a Logical (HOW) error, attributing organic local protests over physical resources to a coordinated foreign cyber campaign without a shred of evidence.

The Unavoidable Lie: Protests against these facilities are just a ginned-up Chinese bot conspiracy.
